title: eqty.lineage component configuration
description: Settings for one EQTY lineage recorder component inside NeMo Relay.

manifest_dir.description: Directory manifests are written to, resolved relative to Relay's working directory. One manifest per session, named by session id.

triples.description: Write the RDF triples sidecar alongside the manifest.

deny_globs.description: Paths whose contents are withheld. A matching file still becomes a graph node carrying its path and its true content CID, computed before redaction; only the bytes are withheld. Provenance does not require publication.

max_content_bytes.description: Content larger than this is recorded by CID and metadata, without storing its bytes.
